title: Extended Golay product with a direct received-word table

claims.statement: For the explicit encoder comprising 83 extended Golay blocks and a twice-sent four-bit tail, and the deterministic chosen-syndrome-leader table decoder with first-copy tail decoding defined in proof.md, the average block error under a uniform 1000-bit message on the memoryless BSC(1/10) with 2000 channel uses is at most 9999999874256283/10000000000000000.

For the same 83-block extended Golay encoder and chosen-syndrome-leader table decoder with first-copy tail decoding, the straight-line bsc-ops-v1 program specified in verify.py uses exactly W=569 operations on every 2000-bit received word, with W <= 2^(9153/1000).

experiments.purpose: Enumerate the chosen leaders and the full direct lookup table, verify the exact block-error bound, count the fixed RAM instruction schedule and verify the integer-exponent cost comparison, and exercise the schedule on representative words.
